scope: dark-tone-floor resilience for any future Hwao-authored method-only iteration
simulation_limit: The transform is a deterministic integer-luma-preserving dark-tone floor followed by full-range remapping. Code-value floors are packet parameters, not claims about a named display, transfer function, codec, player, platform, service, room, projector, viewer, camera, or perception standard.

transform_contract.remap: Y2=max(Y-floor,0)*255/(255-floor), integer round-half-up; RGB2=RGB*Y2/Y, integer round-half-up

severe_floor_48_characterization.human_visual_finding: Major result headlines, large numbers, bright bars, matrices, plot silhouettes, and conclusion hierarchy remain primary while dark background texture, gridlines, axes, error bars, legends, caveats, citations, provenance, and low-luminance context are heavily suppressed.

fresh_candidate_evidence.finding: The failed candidate's bright assertion hierarchy remains almost fully readable after most dark context is mapped to black. No structural held boundary appears. Dark-tone loss neither repairs nor authorizes the candidate.

severe_floor_48.characterization_note: Dark card fills and background texture collapse toward black; required labels, borders, arrows, connectors, rails, status columns, gates, badges, and qualifiers remain distinct. Tiny citation/provenance copy is not a required carrier.

method_only_evidence.finding: The pass-12 strengthened proof already passes the floor-16 operational review and retains all required meaning even at the floor-48 characterization. No additional worker-side pixel or copy correction is evidence-justified.

operational_acceptance_floor.variant: integer-luma-preserving dark-tone floor 16/255 followed by full-range remap, native 1920x1080 RGB
operational_acceptance_floor.role: packet-specific integration review floor, not a universal display, transfer, player, room, platform, service, or viewer standard
requirements: Seven of seven exact strengthened scene-specific gate lines remain visually readable and reach at least 0.85 normalized character similarity under the recorded cropped multi-PSM aid.
Seven of seven complete RESULT HELD capsules remain visually readable.
Large RESULT LOCKED, FRAME UNSTATED, OUTCOMES WITHHELD, and RESULT STATUS HELD boundaries remain primary.
Header, gate, badge, headline, cards, and diagrams remain separated with no clipping or semantic ambiguity.
Arrows, borders, connectors, condition rails, and status columns remain distinguishable through direct labels plus geometry.

No required scientific qualifier, unresolved boundary, unavailable rung, interpretation limit, branch distinction, axis, error bar, or provenance fact is carried only by pixels whose source luma is at or below code value 16.
Dark fill and background texture may be decorative only; required boundaries require a readable label and a surviving border, connector, capsule, or stable position.
Human full-sheet and full-resolution review remains decisive; OCR and pixel metrics are aids only.
